definitions: A living plant cutting, typically a branch or stem, that is inserted directly into the ground or a streambank to root and grow, often used for erosion control or habitat restoration.
A stake cut from a living tree or shrub that is capable of rooting and growing when planted.
examples: They used live stakes to stabilize the riverbank.
The bioengineering project incorporated willow live stakes.
Planting live stakes is an effective method for riparian restoration.
